summary: Validated new flex-row layout in CosechasTab (PlantacionDetail) at viewport 1920. 'Calidades del lote' and 'Rendimiento por planta' render side-by-side at ~half width each in the same row; 'Calidades por variedad' renders below at full width. Donut, legends, rendimiento table and variety pies all rendered with correct data. No runtime errors and no duplicated test ids.

issues: Recharts console warnings 'width(-1) height(-1)' emitted on initial render of the variety pies (cosmetic only; charts render correctly on next tick). Could be silenced by giving the grid items an explicit min-width or initial height, but does not affect UX.

critical_code_review_comments: Layout meets the spec exactly (flex row, gap 18, flexWrap, two cards with flex 1 1 320px side-by-side, variedad full-width below).
Donut reduced to 190x190 (outerRadius 84) as requested; central kg text still visible.

Recharts ResponsiveContainer occasionally logs width/height(-1) warnings at mount inside the grid cells of 'Calidades por variedad'; functionally harmless but worth wrapping the chart wrapper with a small minHeight/minWidth=0 to silence.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Measured rects at 1920 viewport: calidades-chart x=590 w=479 top=355; rendimiento-card x=1087 w=479 top=355 (same row, both ~half of 976 wrap); variedad-chart top=659 w=976 (full width below).
